Name: Aimon's Tidy Cozy Farmhouse
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][color=#f9cb9c][size=2][font=Trebuchet MS][i]Changes your FarmHouse map into a tidier and cozier place towards more realistic layout.
Comes with bath pool, balcony, attic and rooftop! 
Lots of config options available - tweak and adjust the layout as you like![/i][/font][/size][/color][/center]

[left][b][color=#ffe599][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]How to relocate the Crib:[/font][/size][/color][/b][/left]
[left][/left]
[spoiler][left][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]By default Crib is located in Bedroom, its coordinates corresponds to x26 y12 (where 'y' is highest left corner of crib's hitbox tile). 
To move it, do next:[/font][/size][/left]
[left][list=1]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]In my mod's config,  set "[b] Crib Position " [/b]to[b]  "Custom".[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Go to [u]Stardew Valley\Mods\Aimon's Tidy Cozy Farmhouse\assets\code[/u]  subfolder;[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Find [u]crib_relocation.json[/u] file, open it with any text editor. [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Find the string: [/font][/size][/*]
[/list][/left]
[left][code]"MapProperties": {
        "mushymato.MMAP_CribPosition": "x y"
      },[/code][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]   5. Edit numbers in  "mushymato.MMAP_CribPosition": "x y"  to your desired coordinates. [/font][/size][/left]
[left][font=Trebuchet MS]   [size=3]6. Save and close the file.[/size][/font][/left]
[left][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#f6b26b]* You can make this change while in game, but after editing the json file, put this command in your SMAPI console so the game can hook up the change:[/color][/font][/size][/left]
[left][code]patch reload Aimon111.AimonsTidyCozyFarmhouse[/code][/left]
[/spoiler]
[left]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#ffe599]How to make your own Rooftop recolor:[/color][/b][/font][/size]

[spoiler][list=1]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]In my mod's config,  set "[b]Rooftop Recolor" [/b]to[b]  "Custom".[/b][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Go to [u]Stardew Valley\Mods\Aimon's Tidy Cozy Farmhouse\assets\Tilesheets\recolors_rooftop [/u]    subfolder;[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Find these 4 files: [/font][/size][/*]
[/list][code]TidyCozyRoof_fall_Custom.png
TidyCozyRoof_spring_Custom.png
TidyCozyRoof_summer_Custom.png
TidyCozyRoof_winter_Custom.png[/code][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]  4. Open them with any image editor. [/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]  5. Edit colors manually with eyedrop tool or by playing with hue/saturation slider.[/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]  6. Save the files. [/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#f6b26b]* You can make this change while in game, but after editing the json file, put this command in your SMAPI console so the game can hook up the change:[/color][/font][/size]
[code]patch reload Aimon111.AimonsTidyCozyFarmhouse[/code][/spoiler]

[font=Trebuchet MS][b][size=3]First of all - [u]download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16507]Farmhouse Fixes[/url] [/u]mod and [u]enable " Non-Hardcoded Warps"[/u] in it's config. There's some hardcoded stuff exist that this mod fixes. For example, it fixes wrong warps from balcony, fixes empty spouse rooms and cellar entrance disappearing.[/size][/b][/font]

[spoiler][left][list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]When starting a new save/ installing on already existing save,  furniture, bed and player will be stuck in walls.
There's no fix to it right now.  Use  Noclip Mod  (which, after installing, can be toggled py pressing F11 button) to get out of the wall and relocate the furniture.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Same goes for deinstalling  - make sure to pickup all your furniture, chests, crops from farmhouse, attic and balcony maps; and store it outside the farmhouse map. Then save the day and remove my mod from Mods folder. After deinstall - you will spawn in black void. Use CJB Cheats Menu to warp to Farm and enter the farmhouse again, warps will be fixed. [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][u][b]DO NOT[/b] toggle on/off 1st and 2nd farmhouse upgrades the day before farmhouse upgrade.[/u] Enable it only the day AFTER house upgrade happened! Enabling it before the upgrade may cause the game to crash during the overnight save, resulting in the loss of your day's progress.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Robin's Renovations won't work  - all the renovations are deleted by my mod, so do not buy them. For tweaking farmhouse, use config options my mod provides. I know this method lacks immersion but its easier to code and adjust on modder's side, I hope you'll understand.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Buggy Dining Room renovation tiles - if my mod installed on already existing file and you encounter messed up wall tiles in left corner of farmouse.
Fix: remove Dining Room in Robin's renovationmenu, save your day progress and reload save file.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Spouse rooms don't have special NPC decor, such as Sebastian's Terrarium or Emily's Parrot - can't fix it for now. [/font][/size][/*]
